metadata.title: My Favorite American Buttercream Recipe! (Vanilla and chocolate)
metadata.description:
Hello! 

I hope you enjoyed my version of American Buttercream. I have listed my recipe below. Thanks for watching!

1 Lb. unsalted butter {Softened}
2 Lb. powdered sugar
About 1/4 cup milk
Vanilla extract
Pinch of salt

A few things to keep in mind:
-You must have a stand or hand mixer for this recipe, it cannot be made by hand!
-Your butter needs to be SOFT. It cannot be cold in any way or it will not cream properly. I usually set mine out the night before I am ready to use it.
-My perfect ratio is 2 pounds powdered sugar to 1 pound of butter. Experiment to see what works best for you!

This video shows a demonstration on making a buttercream icing.  The video starts with a logo on a colorful background, then proceeds to a "How to" series. The title of this section is, "American Crusting Buttercream AMBC - custard based buttercream".

summary.brief: A baker mixes butter, sugar, milk and vanilla in a stand mixer to create buttercream and then pipes the frosting onto three cupcakes.
summary.detailed: The video opens with colorful “Cake Tube Recipes” graphics and title cards that introduce “My Favorite American Buttercream” while comparing American, meringue‑ and custard‑based buttercreams. At about 26 seconds a person places several softened butter bars into a metal mixing bowl attached to a stand mixer and runs the mixer on low to medium speed. The butter softens, melts, and a small amount of liquid is added; the bowl is scraped with a spatula and the mixture is mixed again. Whole milk is poured in from a red polka‑dot cup, followed by a gradual addition of powdered sugar. Two spoonfuls of butter and vanilla extract (with an equal amount of milk) are added in stages, each time the mixture is mixed, the sides are scraped, and the speed is adjusted. After about five minutes of alternating mixing and scraping the buttercream becomes light, fluffy and smooth, with a pinch of salt added near the end. The finished buttercream is transferred to a piping bag, and the baker swirls the frosting onto three cupcakes, moving the tip in alternating clockwise and counter‑clockwise motions. The video ends with split‑screen clips of additional decorating steps and a thumbnail graphic displaying a subscribe button.

action.detailed: Using a stand mixer, add softened butter to the bowl, mix on medium speed while scraping the sides, gradually incorporate powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla, continue mixing until the mixture is light, fluffy and smooth, then transfer the buttercream to a piping bag and pipe it onto three cupcakes.

summary.detailed: The video begins with several blocks of softened butter being poured into a large metal mixing bowl attached to a light‑turquoise stand mixer. The mixer runs on medium speed while the presenter periodically stops to scrape the sides of the bowl with a green spatula, creaming the butter until it turns pale and fluffy. Next, granulated sugar is added and mixed, followed by the cracking of an egg which is beaten in. After a short pause, a small amount of additional butter is folded in with the spatula and the mixer is started again. Whole milk is then poured from a red polka‑dot cup, and powdered sugar is added spoon by spoon, each addition being mixed and the bowl scraped. Vanilla extract and an equal amount of milk are poured together, and a pinch of salt is sprinkled in. The mixer is run until the mixture is light, airy and smooth, forming a vanilla buttercream. Finally, cocoa powder is added to part of the batch and mixed until the color turns chocolate, producing a chocolate buttercream. Throughout, the background remains out of focus, a green‑striped cloth rests beside the bowl, and the mixer’s whisk and speed knob are clearly visible.

action.detailed: Using a stand mixer, cream softened butter, then add sugar, beat in an egg, incorporate additional butter, pour milk, gradually fold in powdered sugar while scraping the bowl, mix in vanilla and a pinch of salt until the mixture is fluffy, and finally stir in cocoa powder to make chocolate buttercream.
